name: Imperial Mandate

passives.name: Control
passives.effects: Abilities with immobilizing effects have their cooldown reduced equivalent to 15 ability haste.

passives.name: Command
passives.effects: Immobilizing an enemy champion marks them as Vulnerable for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 6%. Subsequent immobilizes against a target extend the duration of the effect.
